animation_engine:
from manim import *
class Scene1(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # Home
        home = SVGMobject('/Users/dheerajgautam/Documents/ai_studio/quick_board_ai/media/svgs/urban/home-2.svg').set_color(WHITE)
        self.play(Create(home), run_time=1)
        self.wait(1)

        # School
        school = SVGMobject('/Users/dheerajgautam/Documents/ai_studio/quick_board_ai/media/svgs/education/school.svg').set_color(WHITE)
        self.play(FadeOut(home), home.animate.shift(DOWN * 2.5), Create(school), run_time=1)
        self.wait(1)

        # Park
        park = SVGMobject('/Users/dheerajgautam/Documents/ai_studio/quick_board_ai/media/svgs/activity/ball-tennis.svg').set_color(WHITE)
        self.play(FadeOut(school), school.animate.shift(DOWN * 2.5), Create(park), run_time=1)
        self.wait(8)
